findingDetails.title: A pronoun rerun after a symptom is read as a doctor ask
findingDetails.claim: isStuckRunComplaint cancels the stuck reading only for an ask that names the loop or a counted ask, so a prompt like 'the deep review didn't finish, run it again' leaves the stuck reading standing and attachCommand answers /doctor:deep-loop although the reader asked for a rerun.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both exported predicates were exercised on the built copy of the reviewed source; the asking and cancelling paths sit in the reviewed file.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read isStuckRunComplaint, hasUnrefusedRunAsk, COUNTED_RUN_ASK, LOOP_RUN_REQUESTED and the doctor branch of attachCommand; REQ-018 and REQ-024 cover only the negated symptom and the refusal shapes, and REQ-024 deliberately keeps the doctor on a plain stuck complaint.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Diagnosing before rerunning is a defensible product choice, and the packet never promises that a pronoun rerun wins.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Withdraw if the packet records doctor-before-rerun as intended, or a guards case already pins the pronoun form.
